summary: Frontend-only test (mobile 390x844) of usual cupboards per zone in the Boat Inventory Set Up Wizard and the empty-zone 'Add the usual <Zone> cupboards' button. Account: test-admin-1 main boat (wizard opens on load). All 5 requested areas PASS. (1) Blank schematic path: dropped Galley + Saloon, pressed Next. setup-done-cupboards said '10 in all'. Boat Inventory then showed 'Galley - 8' and 'Saloon - 2', and the server copy matched. Fridge/Freezer were set as food+drinks and Pantry/Dry Food/Hanging Basket as food. (2) Magically Place Colours path: uploaded the Model Vessel plan image through zone-search-upload-input and chose 'Use whole picture'. The AI placed 10 colours in about 15s. Toast: 'Magic Mariner placed 10 colours and added 15 cupboards for those zones'. Pressing Next did not double the count (done panel '15 in all'). Groups: Galley 8, Saloon 2, Nav station 4, Forward cabin 1. (3) No doubling: I seeded an unzoned 'Fridge' and an 'Oven' already in Engine room. The Fridge was filed under Galley. The Oven stayed in Engine room and was not duplicated, so Galley had 8, not 9 (correct). There were 16 unique names and no duplicates. (4) Empty zone window: I placed Nav station by hand on the Boat Inventory overview. This added nothing on its own. zone-dialog-nav-station showed 'NAV STATION - 0', the usual button 'Add the usual Nav station cupboards' and the names 'Nav Desk, Bookshelf, Instrument Panel, Nav Locker'. Tapping it showed the toast '4 usual cupboards added to Nav station...', the label changed to 'NAV STATION - 4', the usual box went away, and the cupboards were saved. Forward Head (no usual set) showed no usual box. An empty Saloon showed the box; after a quick-add cupboard it went away. Crew (test-welcome-crew on test-user-pro/main): tapping the zone shows only the toast 'No Nav station photos yet', with no zone dialog and no usual box. (5) Regression: Boat Inventory's own Magically Place Colours (after removing the Saloon cupboards in the DB) gave the toast '...placed 10 colours and added 2 cupboards...' and Saloon showed again. Quick add, Make sure you capture, Take photos/gallery buttons and Done still work in the zone dialog. Photo upload itself was not tested.

ui_bugs.issue: The 6s Magic Mariner success toast (sonner, bottom-center) sits over setup-colours-next-btn on a 390px screen, so the Next tap hits the toast. Hovering pauses the toast, and the Playwright click was blocked for 30s. Real users have to wait for it to go. Consider moving the toaster up or the toast to the top while the wizard is open.

issues: The 'Make sure you capture' list starts with 'A wide shot of the whole saloon first' for Nav station. zoneChecklist puts saloon/chart/nav under one list. This was already there and is cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: BoatPrep.setupZoneDefaults and InventoryList.addZoneDefaults do the same thing (count from render-time areas, then apply inside mutate/onChange on the latest list). They could be one helper. The count comes from the render-time closure while the change is applied to the latest state, so the toast/done count can drift from what is actually added if areas changed between render and call. Unlikely, but possible.

withZoneDefaults only matches top-level areas (no parent_id). A folder or box named 'Fridge' inside a cupboard does not stop a new top-level 'Fridge' being made. This is probably fine, but there will be two 'Fridge' names.

Wizard Next calls zoneDefaults(map.swatches) again after Magic Place. That is safe (returns 0), but it also means that if the skipper deletes a usual cupboard during the colours step, Next adds it back.

rca of the issue: Customer case 'GALLEY - 0' after the wizard. Before this change, the wizard's OverviewMap did not give the placed zones their default cupboards, so zones such as Galley had nothing filed under them. This is now fixed in both paths: Magic Place (onZoneDefaults in autoPlace) and the blank schematic (zoneDefaults on Next). Existing boats get the empty-zone usual button.
